Yahweh's word reminds us to pursue peace whenever possible, recognizing the complex realities that often hinder such efforts. Even when peace seems elusive, the call to strive for it remains a constant aspiration.

title.en: EU leaders sign joint statement in support of Ukraine - Europe live

Such diplomatic endeavors, though challenging, are vital steps towards a more...

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.

title.en: Lebanon says Israeli strikes kill 18 as Israel says four soldiers killed by Hezbollah
title.zh: 黎巴嫩称以色列袭击致18人死亡，以色列称四名士兵被真主党打死

summary.en: Lebanon has reported that Israeli strikes killed 18 people, while Israel stated that four of its soldiers were killed by Hezbollah. This escalation occurred a day after the US and Iran reportedly signed an agreement aimed at ending their conflict, including hostilities in Lebanon.
summary.zh: 黎巴嫩称以色列袭击造成18人死亡，而以色列则表示其四名士兵被真主党打死。此次冲突升级发生在美国和伊朗据称签署了一项旨在结束包括黎巴嫩境内敌对行动在内的冲突协议的第二天。

body.en:
At least 18 people have been killed in southern Lebanon following a series of Israeli air strikes overnight, the country's health ministry has said - while the Israeli military says four of its soldiers were also killed.

The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) said it had struck 80 targets linked to the Iran-backed armed group Hezbollah and killed "dozens" of its members.

It comes a day after the US and Iran signed a deal aimed at ending the conflict in the Middle East, including a permanent cessation of hostilities in Lebanon.

Both Israel and Hezbollah have carried out strikes against each other since the agreement was announced, raising questions about the future of the truce between the US and Iran.

The US-Iran deal calls for an end to hostilities on all fronts, and for Lebanon's territorial integrity and sovereignty to be respected.

However, Israel has said it has no intention of withdrawing its forces from Lebanon and has insisted that its conflict with Hezbollah is separate from the war on Iran.

Lebanon's state news agency described the overnight bombardment across the Nabatieh district of southern Lebanon on Thursday as one of the most intense of the war, with at least 18 killed, 33 injured and several buildings hit.

Hezbollah said it had ambushed an Israeli group in southern Lebanon, destroying three tanks with guided missiles, and targeting troops with rocket and artillery fire.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu extended his condolences to the four soldiers, writing on X on Friday that he had instructed the IDF to "strike Hezbollah with full force".

"My directive is clear: Israel will not tolerate attacks on our soldiers or our territory, and it will exact a very heavy price from Hezbollah for these attacks," he said.

Lebanon was drawn into the war between Israel, the US and Iran shortly after it began, with Hezbollah launching rockets into Israel in retaliation for a strike that killed Iran's supreme leader.

Israel responded by launching a bombing campaign across Lebanon and occupying around 5% of the country's territory in the south, with the aim of driving back Hezbollah fighters from its northern border.

At least 3,912 people have been killed, among them women and children, and a further 11,699 others wounded since the latest conflict began, according to Lebanon's health ministry.

Around a million people remain displaced, while dozens of communities in the south have been completely destroyed.

Hezbollah has vowed to continue with its attacks as long as the invasion persists.

Netanyahu is under domestic pressure to continue military operations against the armed group, which could put him on a collision course with US President Donald Trump, who has publicly criticised Israel's conduct in Lebanon.

Yahweh's words remind us of the profound truth that resorting to the sword ultimately leads to further destruction for all involved.

title.en: Over-reliance on chatbots can diminish critical-thinking skills, study finds
title.zh: 研究发现：过度依赖聊天机器人会削弱批判性思维能力

summary.en: A new study from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology indicates that excessive reliance on chatbots can lead to a decline in critical-thinking skills. Researchers also suggest that this dependency may reduce an individual's capacity to identify misinformation.
summary.zh: 麻省理工学院的一项新研究表明，过度依赖聊天机器人可能会削弱批判性思维能力。研究人员还指出，这种依赖性可能降低个人辨别虚假信息的能力。

body.en: Depending on AI can also potentially decrease the ability to discern misinformation, research says A new study from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology is the latest research to find that relying too much on chatbots can diminish critical-thinking skills, and potentially decrease our ability to discern misinformation for ourselves. As AI tools are becoming more sophisticated and accessible, manipulated images and misleading headlines are becoming more common. AI can be part of the solution, and has proved useful in helping users identify fake content – but there’s a cost to using it this way, the new research suggests. An over-dependence on AI to help figure out what’s real on the internet can lead to trouble making those judgments. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究表明，依赖人工智能还可能降低辨别错误信息的能力麻省理工学院的一项最新研究发现，过度依赖聊天机器人会削弱批判性思维能力，并可能降低我们自己辨别错误信息的能力。随着人工智能工具变得越来越复杂和易于使用，操纵图像和误导性标题变得越来越常见。人工智能可以成为解决方案的一部分，并且已被证明在帮助用户识别虚假内容方面很有用，但新研究表明，以这种方式使用它是有成本的。过度依赖人工智能来帮助弄清楚互联网上的真实情况可能会导致做出这些判断时遇到困难。继续阅读...

Yahweh's wisdom encourages us to be thoughtful and prudent, carefully considering our steps rather than passively accepting everything we encounter. Cultivating critical thinking helps us navigate complex information and guard against...
reflection.zh: 这项研究强调了在信息唾手可得的时代，即使是来自人工智能的信息，主动辨别的重要性。雅伟的智慧鼓励我们深思熟虑、谨慎行事，而不是被动地接受所遇到的一切。培养批判性思维有助于我们驾驭复杂信息，并防范虚假信息。

verse.textEn: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.
verse.textZh: 愚蒙人是话都信；通达人步步谨慎。

title.en: Datacenters driving US clean energy growth while still threatening climate
title.zh: 数据中心推动美国清洁能源增长，但仍威胁气候

summary.en: Datacenters are significantly boosting the US clean energy sector, but their substantial energy demands also contribute to climate concerns. This situation is prompting major technology companies to invest in their own power generation solutions.
summary.zh: 数据中心正在显著推动美国清洁能源产业的增长，但其巨大的能源需求也引发了对气候的担忧。这种局面促使大型科技公司投资于自己的发电解决方案。

body.en: As datacenters’ connections to electric grids are held up, big tech is forced to throw money at producing its own power Datacenters are driving unprecedented growth in the US clean energy industry, paradoxically boosting a sector that was sputtering before the artificial intelligence boom even as AI’s rollout creates immense environmental challenges. However, observers caution that while the centers are propelling wind, solar, and other clean energy companies, datacenters remain a climate nightmare. Continue reading...
body.zh: 由于数据中心与电网的连接受到阻碍，大型科技公司被迫投入大量资金来生产自己的电力。数据中心正在推动美国清洁能源行业前所未有的增长，矛盾的是，尽管人工智能的推出带来了巨大的环境挑战，但它却推动了在人工智能繁荣之前就陷入困境的行业。然而，观察人士警告说，虽然这些中心正在推动风能、太阳能和其他清洁能源公司的发展，但数据中心仍然是气候噩梦。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news highlights the complex challenge of technological advancement and its environmental footprint. While datacenters drive clean energy innovation, their overall impact reminds us that the earth and its fullness belong to Yahweh. We are called to steward creation responsibly, seeking wisdom to balance progress with care for the planet.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻凸显了技术进步及其环境足迹的复杂挑战。尽管数据中心推动了清洁能源创新，但其整体影响提醒我们，大地和其中所充满的都属于雅伟。我们蒙召要负责任地管理受造物，寻求智慧以平衡发展与对地球的关怀。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: The collapse of 'world order' as an opportunity for Asia?
title.zh: “世界秩序”的崩溃对亚洲而言是机遇吗？

summary.en: In Europe, changes to international norms and institutional systems are often interpreted as a loss. However, these changes may also mark the beginning of a new, more inclusive order, particularly as some in Asia view them as an opportunity.
summary.zh: 在欧洲，国际规范和制度体系数十年的变化常被解读为一种损失。然而，这些变化也可能标志着一个更具包容性的新秩序的开始，尤其是在亚洲，有时被视为机遇。

body.en:
In Europe—unlike in Asia—changes to decades of international norms and institutional systems are often interpreted as a loss. However, these changes may also mark the beginning of a new, more inclusive order.

Russia's war of aggression against Ukraine on the European Union's eastern flank, the United States' disregard and contempt for the international order under President Donald Trump, and the allegations that Israel has violated humanitarian law in the Middle East conflict have shocked many Europeans .

The world order that took shape after World War II appears to have come to an end. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz stated at the Munich Security Conference in February 2026: "This order, as imperfect as it was even in its best days, no longer exists in that form." 

However, in Asia, political observers are often surprised at the consternation of some Europeans. During the Shangri-La Dialogue, an annual Asian security conference held in Singapore, former Singaporean diplomat Bilahari Kausikan told DW "Europe thought the jungle had been tamed for good. And then it got a shock."

"Competition and conflict are fundamental characteristics of international relations. These enduring, harsh truths were obscured for a brief period—perhaps about 20 years from the fall of the Berlin Wall to the outbreak of the global financial crisis. This was an extraordinary phase in world history," he added.

Marc Saxer, Asia Pacific head of Germany's Friedrich-Ebert-Foundation, told DW that European and Asian worldviews are shaped by different historical experiences. Under the protective umbrella of United States , Europe was able to dream of a liberal world order. For Asia, that was unthinkable.

Saxer considers efforts to maintain a liberal world order to have failed, and he believes that "a return by the US to the role it played until the 2010s is impossible for structural reasons."

The political analyst said the unipolar era is definitely over, as the US has overextended itself strategically with conflict zones in Europe, the Middle East and the Asia-Pacific.

Thomas Kleine-Brockhoff, director of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP), told DW that the US under Trump is now attempting to "establish a hegemonic world of great powers, a kind of global directorate along with Russia and China," amounting to spheres of influence controlled by great powers.

As a result, international law and multilateral institutions such as the United Nations are being undermined by the United States, China and Russia (each for its own reasons and with its own intentions).

body.zh: 在欧洲，与亚洲不同，几十年来国际规范和制度体系的变化常常被解读为一种损失。然而，这些变化也可能标志着一个更具包容性的新秩序的开始。 俄罗斯在欧盟东翼发动对乌克兰的侵略战争、美国对唐纳德·特朗普总统领导下的国际秩序的无视和蔑视，以及以色列在中东冲突中违反人道主义法的指控，令许多欧洲人感到震惊。 第二次世界大战后形成的世界秩序似乎已经结束。德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨 (Friedrich Merz) 在 2026 年 2 月的慕尼黑安全会议上表示：“这一秩序即使在最好的时候也是不完美的，但现在已经不复存在了。” 然而，在亚洲，政治观察家常常对一些欧洲人的惊愕感到惊讶。在新加坡举行的一年一度的亚洲安全会议香格里拉对话期间，新加坡前外交官比拉哈里·考斯坎 (Bilahari Kausikan) 告诉德国之声：“欧洲原以为丛林已经被永久驯服了。但随后他们感到震惊。” “竞争和冲突是国际关系的基本特征。从柏林墙倒塌到全球金融危机爆发，这些持久而严酷的事实在一段时间内被掩盖了——大约20年。这是世界历史上一个非同寻常的阶段，”他补充道。 德国弗里德里希·艾伯特基金会亚太区负责人马克·萨克瑟向德国之声表示，欧洲和亚洲的世界观是由不同的历史经历塑造的。在美国的保护伞下，欧洲得以梦想建立自由的世界秩序。对于亚洲来说，这是不可想象的。 Saxer 认为维持自由世界秩序的努力已经失败，他认为“由于结构性原因，美国不可能恢复 2010 年代之前所扮演的角色”。 这位政治分析人士表示，单极时代肯定已经结束，因为美国在欧洲、中东和亚太地区冲突地区的战略扩张过度。 德国外交关系委员会(DGAP)主任托马斯·克莱恩-布罗克霍夫(Thomas Kleine-Brockhoff)向德国之声表示，特朗普领导下的美国现在正试图“建立一个大国霸权世界，与俄罗斯和中国一起建立一个全球理事会”，相当于由大国控制的势力范围。 结果，国际法和联合国等多边机构正在受到美国、中国和俄罗斯的破坏（每个机构都有自己的原因和意图）。 萨克瑟出版了一本同名书，他表示，结果是一个“狼世界”，意思是一个“强者法则战胜强者力量的世界……”

reflection.en: The shifting global landscape, where old norms are challenged, highlights the critical need for clear vision. Without a shared understanding of the path forward, societies can drift into uncertainty or chaos. title.en: Obama moved to tears by wife Michelle's speech
title.zh: 奥巴马被妻子米歇尔的演讲感动落泪

summary.en: Former President Barack Obama was visibly moved to tears by his wife Michelle Obama's speech during the opening of a new site in Chicago. The former president described the new site as a "celebration of community."
summary.zh: 前总统巴拉克·奥巴马在芝加哥一个新场馆的开幕式上，被妻子米歇尔·奥巴马的演讲感动落泪。这位前总统将该场馆描述为“社区的庆典”。

body.en:
Former US President Barack Obama was visibly moved as his wife Michelle Obama saluted his work during the opening of the new Obama Presidential Center in Chicago.

He appeared to wipe away a tear as his wife, the former first lady, hailed his achievements in office, including his efforts to expand healthcare and his attainment of a Nobel Peace Prize.

The latter remark was widely interpreted as a jibe at his successor, Donald Trump, who has coveted the same accolade during his own time in office.

Living former presidents Bill Clinton, George W Bush and Joe Biden attended the event but Trump, who has long feuded with the Obamas, was not invited.

The Chicago attraction, a monument to the eight years the couple spent in the White House, has been in the works since Obama, the 44th president, left the Oval Office a decade ago.

The Obamas chose the Jackson Park neighbourhood on the South Side for the 20-acre campus, near the home where they lived before moving to the White House.

Obama said he hoped the centre would "remind us what we can achieve when we embrace our shared responsibilities as citizens".

Michelle Obama used her speech to address her husband directly and salute his resilience. "Barack, you gotta look at me," she said, drawing laughter from her audience. "Eight years in the crucible and not once did you melt from the heat."

Her husband had done "the people's work", she went on to say, touting his record on the economy and the raid that killed Osama Bin Laden, alongside his achievements on healthcare and the Nobel prize.

Barack Obama had been held to a "higher standard" as America's first black president, she added. She told her husband he had battled "lies about your birthright, your faith, your patriotism".

When he took the microphone, Barack Obama addressed the emotions of the day, saying of his wife: "She knew she was going to mess me up, and she did it anyway."

Obama, who was president from 2009-17, told visitors that the centre had been planned as a "vibrant, living celebration of community".

Like his wife, he did not mention Trump by name, but made pointed remarks that were interpreted by analysts as rebukes of the current administration.

He suggested that America was currently experiencing "anger and vision" but that Americans were "looking for fairness and common sense and mutual respect".

Other dignitaries attending Thursday's event included former German Chancellor Angela Merkel and former Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau, who were both in office during Obama's tenure.

Artists including Jennifer Hudson, Christina Aguilera, John Legend, Common, Marc Anthony, U2's Bono and The Edge performed, as well as Bruce Springsteen and Stevie Wonder.

Rock legend and hometown hero Eddie Vedder, the Illinois-born frontman of...
body.zh: 在芝加哥新奥巴马总统中心落成典礼上，美国前总统巴拉克·奥巴马 (Barack Obama) 明显被妻子米歇尔·奥巴马 (Michelle Obama) 向他的工作致敬而感动。 当他的妻子、前第一夫人称赞他在任期间取得的成就时，他似乎擦去了眼泪，包括他为扩大医疗保健所做的努力以及获得诺贝尔和平奖。 后一言论被广泛解读为对他的继任者唐纳德·特朗普的嘲笑，特朗普在任职期间就渴望获得同样的荣誉。 在世的前总统比尔·克林顿、乔治·W·布什和乔·拜登出席了此次活动，但与奥巴马家族长期不和的特朗普没有受到邀请。 这座芝加哥景点是纪念这对夫妇在白宫度过的八年时光的纪念碑，自第 44 任总统奥巴马十年前离开椭圆形办公室以来一直在筹建中。 奥巴马夫妇选择了南区的杰克逊公园社区作为占地 20 英亩的校园，靠近他们搬入白宫之前居住的家。 奥巴马表示，他希望该中心能够“提醒我们，当我们承担作为公民的共同责任时，我们能够取得什么成就”。 米歇尔·奥巴马在演讲中直接向她的丈夫讲话，并向他的坚韧致敬。 “巴拉克，你得看着我，”她说，引来观众的笑声。 “在坩埚里呆了八年，你一次也没有被高温融化。” 她接着说，她的丈夫做了“人民的工作”，并吹捧了他在经济方面的记录和击毙奥萨马·本·拉登的突袭行动，以及他在医疗保健和诺贝尔奖方面的成就。 她补充说，作为美国第一位黑人总统，巴拉克·奥巴马一直被要求遵守“更高的标准”。她告诉她的丈夫，他已经与“关于你与生俱来的权利、你的信仰、你的爱国主义的谎言”进行了斗争。 当巴拉克·奥巴马拿起麦克风时，他谈到了当天的情绪，他谈到他的妻子时说：“她知道她会把我搞砸，但她还是这么做了。” 2009-17 年担任总统的奥巴马告诉来访者，该中心被规划为“充满活力、生动的社区庆典”。 和他的妻子一样，他没有提到特朗普的名字，但发表了尖锐的言论，分析人士将其解读为对现任政府的谴责。 他表示，美国目前正在经历“愤怒和愿景”，但美国人正在“寻求公平、常识和相互尊重”。 出席周四活动的其他政要包括德国前总理安格拉·默克尔和加拿大前总理贾斯汀·特鲁多，他们都在奥巴马任期内任职。 詹妮弗·哈德森 (Jennifer Hudson)、克里斯蒂娜·阿奎莱拉 (Christina Aguilera)、约翰·传奇 (John Legend)、Common、马克·安东尼 (Marc Anthony)、U2 的波诺 (Bono) 和 The Edge 等艺术家以及布鲁斯·斯普林斯汀 (Bruce Springsteen) 和史蒂维·旺德 (Stevie Wonder) 都曾参与演出。 摇滚传奇人物和家乡英雄埃迪·维德 (Eddie Vedder)，出生于伊利诺伊州的乐队主唱。

reflection.zh: 一位前总统因妻子在社区活动上的演讲而感动落泪，这突显了共同目标和深厚个人联系的深刻影响。正如雅伟自己也曾流露深情，这样的时刻提醒我们，脆弱和真挚的情感表达是我们人性的强大体现。这些源于爱与自豪的泪水，强调了在伙伴关系和对共同利益的奉献中所蕴含的力量。

title.en: Asia's richest man Ambani announces what could be India's biggest share sale
title.zh: 亚洲首富安巴尼宣布印度最大规模股票发售

summary.en: India's largest telecom operator, led by Asia's richest man, Ambani, has announced what is anticipated to be the country's largest share sale, aiming to raise approximately $4 billion.

body.en:
Jio Platforms, the telecom unit of billionaire Mukesh Ambani's Reliance Industries, has announced what analysts say could be one of India's biggest share sales.

The company's board has approved a draft prospectus for the initial public offering (IPO), Ambani said at Reliance's annual shareholder meeting on Friday.

India's largest telecom operator, which has more than 500 million subscribers, is expected to raise around $4bn (£3.02bn), according to media reports.

Investors will be watching the listing closely as a test of appetite for new offerings after months of volatility in the country's stock markets.

"The proposed listing of Jio will demonstrate to the world that India can build technology companies of global scale, global capability, and global value," Ambani, one of the world's richest men, said.

Launched in 2016, Jio shook up India's telecom sector with low-cost mobile data plans, soon racking up millions of users. The company has since expanded into areas including cloud computing, enterprise services and artificial intelligence.

Last year, Jio and rival Bharti Airtel signed separate deals with Elon Musk's SpaceX to bring the Starlink internet service to India .

The IPO comes after a year-long wait for Jio to go public. Last year, Ambani had said the company would be listed in the first half of 2026.

Unlike the secondary markets, where investors buy and sell existing stocks of companies, IPOs are used by privately held firms to sell their shares to investors for the first time, and debut on the public markets.

The Jio IPO was announced a day after the National Stock Exchange (NSE) filed papers for its long-awaited market debut, adding momentum to India's capital markets.

While details of the offer price and valuation have not yet been disclosed, media reports have estimated that the NSE IPO could raise around more than $3bn.

Together, the Jio and NSE listings would be among India's largest IPOs in recent years, rivalling Hyundai Motor India's $3.3bn blockbuster share sale two years ago.

Jio's listing is especially a close watch for investors and analysts who say a successful offering could boost sentiments in India's IPO market after a recent slowdown in new listings.

In recent years, Jio has expanded its ambitions beyond telecommunications into artificial intelligence and digital infrastructure.

Earlier this month, Meta announced it would lease capacity at an AI-enabled data centre being built by Reliance in the western state of Gujarat. The facility is expected to have a capacity of 168 megawatts.

The agreement builds on a partnership that began in 2020, when Meta invested $5.7bn in Jio.

title.en: Thirty-five killed as gunmen attack Niger's biggest airport
title.zh: 武装分子袭击尼日尔最大机场，造成三十五人死亡

summary.en: Gunmen attacked Niger's largest airport, killing thirty-five people. This incident is part of a decade-long militant Islamist insurgency in the country, with suspected jihadists having attacked the same airport previously in January.
summary.zh: 尼日尔最大的机场遭到武装分子袭击，造成三十五人死亡。此次事件是该国长达十年的伊斯兰武装叛乱的一部分，今年一月，疑似圣战分子也曾袭击同一机场。

body.en:
Thirty-five people have been killed after gunmen struck Niger's largest airport on Thursday, officials say - the second attack in less than five months.

Residents in the predominately Muslim country told the BBC they had just finished their morning prayers when explosions and gunshot sounds rang out from Diori Hamani international airport, located in the capital, Niamey.

Niger's defence ministry said the fatalities comprised 22 assailants, 11 soldiers, and two civilians.

On Thursday evening, al-Qaeda affiliate Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) said it had carried out the attack.

Niger has been fighting an Islamist insurgency for a decade and in January, an organisation linked to the Islamic State group claimed responsibility for an attack on the same airport .

Thursday's violence settled by mid-morning and security forces have since launched a manhunt for any remaining attackers.

Lawalli Tsalha, who lives near the airport, which also hosts a military base, told the BBC: "We finished our prayer at about 05:50 (04:50 GMT) and shortly afterwards we heard a loud bang - like something had exploded, perhaps a tyre.

Authorities said alongside the 22 attackers that were killed, another four were wounded. They added that 20 suspects had been arrested.

A large cache of weapons including RPG-7 launchers, AK-47 rifles, explosives, grenades, communications equipment and thousands of rounds of ammunition were also reportedly seized.

Armed local residents joined the manhunt, though witnesses told the BBC that security personnel attempted to stop civilians getting involved.

One resident, who did not wish to be named, said: "The attackers mixed in with the local population, so finding them was not easy. Civilians picked up machetes and sticks to defend themselves and to strike anyone they did not recognise who came their way."

The airport vicinity had been locked down on Thursday afternoon, with security forces searching vehicles entering and leaving the area.

In a televised statement, the defence ministry blamed "armed mercenaries" for the attack, saying they were sponsored by France, without providing evidence.

The military which seized power in a July 2023 coup have frosty relations with France and regularly accuse it of trying to destabilise Niger, which it denies.

Since the coup, French soldiers based in Niger have been ordered to leave and replaced with Russian military contractors.

African Union Commission Chairperson Mahmoud Ali Youssouf "strongly condemned" the assault and praised Nigerien forces whose actions "made it possible to repel the attack and secure the airport facilities."

body.zh: 官员称，周四，枪手袭击了尼日尔最大的机场，造成 35 人死亡，这是不到五个月内的第二次袭击。 这个穆斯林占主导地位的国家的居民告诉英国广播公司，他们刚刚完成晨祷，首都尼亚美的迪奥里·哈马尼国际机场就传来爆炸声和枪声。 尼日尔国防部表示，死亡人数包括 22 名袭击者、11 名士兵和 2 名平民。 周四晚上，基地组织附属组织伊斯兰努斯拉特穆斯林穆斯林大会 (JNIM) 表示，他们实施了这次袭击。 尼日尔十年来一直在打击伊斯兰叛乱分子，一月份，一个与伊斯兰国组织有联系的组织声称对同一机场的袭击负责。 周四的暴力事件于上午十点左右结束，安全部队此后开始搜捕剩余的袭击者。 住在机场附近的拉瓦利·察哈 (Lawalli Tsalha) 告诉 BBC：“我们在 05:50 左右（格林威治标准时间 04:50）完成了祈祷，不久之后我们听到一声巨响，就像有东西爆炸了，可能是轮胎。 当局表示，除了 22 名袭击者被打死外，另有 4 名袭击者受伤。他们补充说，20 名嫌疑人已被捕。 据报道，还查获了大量武器，包括 RPG-7 发射器、AK-47 步枪、炸药、手榴弹、通讯设备和数千发弹药。 当地武装居民参加了搜捕行动，但目击者告诉英国广播公司，安全人员试图阻止平民参与其中。 一位不愿透露姓名的居民说：“袭击者与当地居民混在一起，所以找到他们并不容易。平民拿起砍刀和棍棒来自卫，并攻击任何他们不认识的人。” 周四下午，机场附近已被封锁，安全部队搜查进出该地区的车辆。 在一份电视声明中，国防部将这次袭击归咎于“武装雇佣军”，称他们是由法国赞助的，但没有提供证据。 在 2023 年 7 月政变中夺取政权的军方与法国关系冷淡，并经常指责法国试图破坏尼日尔的稳定，但法国对此予以否认。 政变以来，驻尼日尔的法国士兵被勒令撤离，并由俄罗斯军事承包商取代。 非洲联盟委员会主席马哈茂德·阿里·优素福“强烈谴责”这次袭击，并赞扬尼日尔军队的行动“击退了袭击并确保了机场设施的安全”。 迪奥里哈马尼国际机场是尼日尔最敏感的安全设施之一，既是民用航空枢纽，又是军事基地……

title.en: US-Iran talks postponed as Vance pulls out of Switzerland trip
title.zh: 美伊会谈因万斯退出瑞士之行而推迟

summary.en: Talks between the United States and Iran, intended to implement a recently signed deal to end the war, have been postponed after a key negotiator withdrew from the trip to Switzerland.
summary.zh: 美国和伊朗之间的会谈原定于关注本周早些时候签署的结束战争协议的实施，但由于一名关键谈判代表退出瑞士之行而被推迟。

body.en:
A new round of direct talks between the US and Iran have been postponed after Vice-President JD Vance delayed a planned trip to Switzerland.

The White House announced late on Thursday that Vance would not be travelling to the talks and said the logistics had not been "simple or predictable".

It comes a day after the US dropped its naval blockade of Iran after the two countries signed a deal aimed at ending the conflict.

While the deal also said fighting should end in Lebanon, the country's health ministry said Israeli strikes had killed at least 18 people in the south overnight.

Israel's military said it had targeted the Iran-backed group Hezbollah, and that four of its own soldiers had been killed.

Hours before the White House issued its statement, Hezbollah-linked Lebanese media reported that the talks had been suspended due to ongoing Israeli air strikes.

Negotiators had been due to meet for what US officials described as "technical discussions" on the next steps of the agreement signed earlier this week .

But Washington said plans for the talks had "not been finalised". It added that the US looked forward to "beginning technical talks as soon as possible".

Switzerland's foreign ministry later confirmed the talks at the Burgenstock mountaintop resort had been "postponed", although it said preparations for talks were continuing.

Swiss military and police officials had been patrolling the luxury hotel set high on a mountain overlooking Lake Lucerne, and a media centre had been set up for journalists.

The negotiations had been expected to focus on implementing the agreement, which is known as a Memorandum of Understanding, and begin discussions on longer-term issues, including Iran's nuclear programme.

Centred around 14 points , the deal includes reopening the Strait of Hormuz, a requirement that Iran will never have a nuclear weapon, a $300bn (£224bn) plan for Iran's "reconstruction", and the US terminating "all types of sanctions" on Iran.

It also binds both sides to achieving a final deal in a "maximum" of 60 days, which could be extended with mutual consent.

Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei said he had approved the deal with the US despite having a "different view", claiming Trump had "out of desperation, used all kinds of leverage" to bring it about.

He said that while there would be "in-person negotiations in the future" between Tehran and Washington, this would "not mean acceptance of the enemy's position".

President Trump has said he expected a ceasefire to take effect "on all fronts", including between Israel and Hezbollah in Lebanon, something which is also set out in the text of the agreement.

But both Israel and Hezbollah have carried out strikes against each other since the deal was announced.

title.en: US curbs Anthropic AI access, raising global concerns
title.zh: 美国限制Anthropic人工智能访问，引发全球担忧

summary.en: The Trump administration has restricted international access to Anthropic's latest AI models, citing security concerns. This move has led to a global shutdown of these models and could impact the Claude-maker's IPO plans, potentially setting a significant global precedent for AI regulation.
summary.zh: 特朗普政府以安全担忧为由，限制了国际社会对Anthropic最新人工智能模型的访问，导致这些模型在全球范围内关闭。此举可能会影响这家Claude制造商的首次公开募股计划，并可能为人工智能监管树立一个深远先例。

body.en:
The Trump administration has restricted foreign access to Anthropic's latest AI models over security fears, forcing a global shutdown. Could the row hurt the Claude-maker's IPO plans and set a far-reaching precedent?

Silicon Valley executives and global policymakers are scratching their heads at US President Donald Trump's latest crackdown on Anthropic, the artificial intelligence (AI) company behind the powerful Claude models.

Just days after the release of its most powerful upgrades — Claude Fable 5 and the even more powerful Mythos 5 — the Trump administration imposed strict export controls on Anthropic's tools on June 12.

Washington cited national security risks from so-called jailbreaking — clever prompts that bypass AI safety rules — which the San Francisco-based tech giant said were minor, overblown and also present in rival AI platforms.

Yet with the US Commerce Department effectively banning foreign nationals worldwide from using the models, including Anthropic's own staff, the firm had little choice but to suspend global access entirely.

Washington's move came days after Anthropic filed plans for a public listing , likely this fall, hoping to raise tens of billions from investors.

In an open letter published on Sunday, a group of more than 170 tech executives warned that the curbs "risked America's AI leadership" by depriving cybersecurity defenders of their strongest tools, while China's capabilities advance rapidly.

At this week's  G7 summit in Evian , France, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi  called for "broad and inclusive" access to US AI models, while the UK requested a carve-out from the ban, which was rejected.

Some European lawmakers, meanwhile, described Washington's ability to shut off access as a "kill switch" that reinforced the need for the European Union to secure its own AI sovereignty.

"We won't buy any models made by these companies if overnight, you can just flip the switch," French President Emmanuel Macron  warned on Wednesday.

Risto Uuk, head of European policy and research at the Future of Life Institute, described the US move as "hasty and uninformed" and called on Washington to set clearer and stronger AI regulations similar to those being rolled out by the EU in August.

AI safety "cannot depend on a single firm's goodwill on a given week," Uuk told DW.

Washington has typically deployed lawfare tactics — legal tools like export controls — against foreign rivals such as China and Russia. 

Targeting an American company like Anthropic, however, sets a dangerous new precedent, say tech experts and policymakers, as it risks undermining investor...
body.zh: 出于安全担忧，特朗普政府限制外国企业访问 Anthropic 的最新人工智能模型，迫使全球范围内关闭。这场争吵是否会损害克劳德制造者的首次公开募股计划并开创一个影响深远的先例？ 硅谷高管和全球政策制定者对美国总统唐纳德·特朗普最近对 Anthropic 的打压感到摸不着头脑，Anthropic 是强大的克劳德模型背后的人工智能 (AI) 公司。 在其最强大的升级版（Claude Fable 5 和更强大的 Mythos 5）发布几天后，特朗普政府于 6 月 12 日对 Anthropic 的工具实施了严格的出口管制。 华盛顿引用了所谓的越狱（绕过人工智能安全规则的巧妙提示）带来的国家安全风险，这家总部位于旧金山的科技巨头表示，这种风险很小，被夸大了，而且也存在于竞争对手的人工智能平台中。 然而，由于美国商务部实际上禁止世界各地的外国人（包括 Anthropic 自己的员工）使用这些模型，该公司别无选择，只能完全暂停全球访问。 华盛顿采取这一举措的几天前，Anthropic 提交了可能在今年秋天公开上市的计划，希望从投资者那里筹集数百亿美元。 在周日发表的一封公开信中，由 170 多名科技高管组成的团体警告称，这些限制措施剥夺了网络安全捍卫者最强大的工具，从而“危及美国的人工智能领导地位”，而中国的能力却在迅速提升。 在本周于法国埃维昂举行的七国集团峰会上，印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪呼吁“广泛且包容”地使用美国人工智能模型，而英国则要求排除该禁令，但遭到拒绝。 与此同时，一些欧洲立法者将华盛顿关闭访问的能力描述为“终止开关”，这强化了欧盟确保自身人工智能主权的必要性。 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙周三警告说：“如果一夜之间，你可以按下开关，我们就不会购买这些公司生产的任何型号。” 生命未来研究所欧洲政策和研究负责人 Risto Uuk 形容美国的举动“仓促且不知情”，并呼吁华盛顿制定更清晰、更强有力的人工智能法规，类似于欧盟 8 月份推出的法规。 尤克告诉德国之声，人工智能安全“不能依赖于某一周某家公司的商誉”。 华盛顿通常会针对中国和俄罗斯等外国竞争对手部署法律策略——出口管制等法律工具。 然而，科技专家和政策制定者表示，针对像 Anthropic 这样的美国公司，开创了一个危险的新先例，因为它可能会损害投资者的利益……

reflection.en: The decision to restrict access to advanced AI models highlights the prudence needed when new technologies present unforeseen risks. It reminds us that foresight and caution are essential to navigate potential dangers, protecting against future harm.
reflection.zh: 限制访问先进人工智能模型的决定，凸显了当新技术带来不可预见的风险时，审慎行事的重要性。它提醒我们，远见和谨慎对于规避潜在危险、防范未来损害至关重要。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

summary.en: US-Iran talks scheduled to take place in Switzerland were postponed shortly after a trip by Vance was cancelled, with a White House spokesperson noting the complex and unpredictable nature of such negotiations.

Switzerland announced Friday that planned talks following up on the deal to end the Middle East war had been postponed, hours after US Vice President JD Vance's departure for the Alpine country was cancelled.

The signing of the accord this week was intended to end the conflict in Iran, reopen the Strait of Hormuz and begin a 60-day period for talks on wider issues, including Iran's nuclear program.

At the same time, the deal was to halt the fighting in Lebanon, but Israel's military announced on Friday new strikes against Hezbollah targets in the nation's south.

"The planned talks between the US, Iran, Qatar and Pakistan have been postponed," the Swiss foreign ministry said in a message to the Agence France-Presse news agency.

"Switzerland remains ready to facilitate these talks. The relevant preparatory work at Burgenstock is continuing," it added, without providing a new date for the talks.

On Friday, Iran's chief negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf warned that Tehran would give a "decisive" response if the agreement was breached.

American forces on Thursday lifted their naval blockade of Iranian ports that had prevented ships from sailing to or from the Islamic republic, the US military said, noting that American warships "will remain in the general area".

Activity was still muted in the Strait of Hormuz, the strategic bottleneck for energy shipments that Iran blockaded during the conflict.

title.en: Who is Andy Burnham, the UK mayor set to challenge Keir Starmer's prime ministership?
title.zh: 英国市长安迪·伯纳姆将挑战基尔·斯塔默的首相职位，他是谁？

summary.en: Andy Burnham, a prominent UK political figure, is reportedly preparing to challenge Keir Starmer for the prime ministership. His career has seen him move between parliament and the mayor's office in Greater Manchester, and he now faces what is described as his most significant political challenge.
summary.zh: 英国政治人物安迪·伯纳姆据报道正准备挑战基尔·斯塔默的首相职位。他的职业生涯曾往返于议会和大曼彻斯特市长办公室之间，现在他面临着其政治生涯中最大的考验。

body.en:
Andy Burnham, a mayor in the United Kingdom, has cleared a path to try to oust UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer after winning a parliamentary seat, in what could be the most consequential local election in more than six decades.

Burnham, the Greater Manchester mayor nicknamed the "King of the North", won the by-election in Makerfield in north-west England representing Labour with 24,927 votes, while the candidate for Nigel Farage's right-wing Reform UK party came second with 15,696 votes.

His victory means he will now be able to trigger, or at least take part in, a contest to replace Starmer, who is struggling with some of the worst popularity ratings of any UK leader. But the key question is when and how Burnham will do it.

"I do say to my own party, this is a final chance to change," Burnham said in his victory speech on Friday. "There will be no second chance."

Polls show Burnham, 56, is Labour's most popular politician who would win a months-long leadership contest decided by party members, while some Labour politicians hope Starmer could be persuaded to hand over power to avoid a damaging contest.

Andy Burnham is a career politician. He was first elected as the member for Leigh in Greater Manchester in 2001. By 2009, he'd risen to secretary of state for health in then-prime minister Gordon Brown's cabinet, a post he held until the Labour government resigned following a general election in 2010, after which he became the shadow secretary of state for health.

When Brown resigned as Labour leader in 2010, Burnham embarked on the first of two failed leadership challenges, running on a personal philosophy of "aspirational socialism". Burnham lost out in that ballot, which went to Ed Miliband. He would become the shadow secretary of state for education in Miliband's cabinet.

Burnham's second challenge came ahead of the 2015 general election, seeking to replace Miliband. He ultimately ran second to Jeremy Corbyn in the party ballot.

He was approached by the city of Greater Manchester in 2016 about potentially running for mayor and leapt at the chance, going on to win with 63 per cent of the vote. He has remained the mayor of Greater Manchester ever since — but will have to give up that role before taking up his parliamentary seat.

Burnham rose to national prominence again during the COVID-19 pandemic after he clashed with then-prime minister Boris Johnson's Conservative government over the level of assistance provided to constituents and businesses during lockdown periods.

title.en: Côte d'Ivoire's Elye Wahi cleared to travel to Canada for World Cup match with Germany
title.zh: 科特迪瓦的埃利耶·瓦希获准前往加拿大参加对阵德国的世界杯比赛

summary.en: Elye Wahi of Côte d'Ivoire has received travel authorization to participate in a World Cup match against Germany, after previously being linked to an investigation into suspected sports corruption.
summary.zh: 科特迪瓦球员埃利耶·瓦希此前曾与一项涉嫌体育腐败的调查有关，现已获准前往加拿大参加对阵德国的世界杯比赛。

body.en:
Côte d'Ivoire forward Elye Wahi has received authorisation to travel to Canada for this weekend's World Cup clash with Germany, the country's football federation said.

The confirmation comes hours after it said he would not be able to travel because he had not received his visa.

"The Ivorian Football Federation (FIF) reports that Elye Wahi's administrative situation has evolved favourably. The necessary authorisations for his entry into Canadian territory have now been obtained," said a statement from the official X account of the Ivorian Football Federation.

A spokesperson for Canada's Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) told Reuters that, in exceptional circumstances, Temporary Resident Permits may be granted to a person who is inadmissible or does not meet the requirements to enter or remain temporarily in Canada.

The IRCC added that, without signed consent, it was not possible to provide details regarding any individual application.

Wahi was linked to an investigation into suspected sports corruption, with French authorities saying unusual betting patterns were detected around a yellow card Wahi received in a Ligue 1 match while playing for Nice last month.

A spokesperson for the Marseille prosecutor's office told Reuters a 23-year-old Ligue 1 player was taken into custody on 29 May as part of an investigation into suspected organised fraud, organised sports corruption, handling stolen goods and money laundering.

"To date, the FIF has not been officially notified of any legal or administrative proceedings concerning him," the FIF said in a statement.

"During this particularly difficult period, the FIF offers its full support to the player and reaffirms its confidence in him. Elye Wahi remains an important member of the Ivory Coast national team."

The FIF earlier said Wahi would not be able to join the delegation’s trip to Canada.

"This is because the administrative authorisations required for him to enter Canadian territory have not yet been obtained. Elye Wahi will therefore remain in the United States until the team returns," it said.

Wahi, who previously represented France at Under-21 level, made his senior international debut for Côte d'Ivoire in March.

Côte d'Ivoire beat Ecuador 1-0 in their first Group E match, while Germany are coming off a 7-1 rout of Curaçao.

summary.en: Vice President JD Vance has begun a media tour to defend Donald Trump's negotiations with Iran, as a 60-day negotiation period commences.

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump's deal with Iran has been sharply criticised by detractors in Israel as well as some Republican hawks, who say the agreement falls far short of the sweeping victory he promised.

Critics said it could leave Iran richer, stronger, and still able to threaten the region.

The memorandum of understanding, signed by Trump in France on Thursday, aims to end months of conflict, reopen the vital Strait of Hormuz, and stabilise energy markets after a war that drove up oil prices and raised fears of a wider Middle East crisis.

But the terms of the agreement have alarmed some of the same Republicans who spent years denouncing former US President Barack Obama's 2015 nuclear agreement with Iran as dangerously weak.

They have voiced concerns that Trump is offering Iran sanctions relief, access to oil markets, and the prospect of a US$300 billion ($427.3 billion) reconstruction fund while failing to secure firm commitments on uranium enrichment, ballistic missiles, or the country's support for armed proxies.

When he launched the war nearly four months ago, Trump said he aimed to destroy Iran's nuclear weapons program, end its ability to strike its neighbours, prevent it from supporting allied militants in the region, and make it possible for Iranians to topple their hardline leaders.

Though he initially demanded Iran's "unconditional surrender", Trump ultimately signed the agreement with none of those objectives met.

The deal gives negotiators 60 days to reach an agreement on the status of Iran's nuclear program and limit its long-range missiles.

Oil tankers sailed through the Strait of Hormuz, and the US said it lifted its blockade on Iran on Friday as the interim deal took effect.

Oil prices dropped to their lowest level since the war began on 28 February, as analysts said exports through the strait — which handles about one-fifth of global oil supply — could return to normal in the coming months.

US vice ‌president JD Vance said the 60-day window "officially started today" while addressing reporters at the White House ‌on Friday.

Asked what happens after the 60-day period regarding the governance of the Strait of Hormuz, Vance reiterated the US view that the major supply route for oil and gas shipments should be free of tolls.

Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei said Trump signed the deal "out of desperation" and signalled that upcoming nuclear talks would not be easy.

"If the American side wants to be too demanding, we will not accept it," he said in a written message.

Yahweh blesses those who work to build bridges and foster understanding, seeking peaceful resolutions amidst complex international relations.
reflection.zh: 在一个常被紧张和分歧所困扰的世界里，即使充满挑战，维护外交途径的努力也是一种缔造和平的行为。雅伟赐福那些致力于搭建桥梁、促进理解、在复杂国际关系中寻求和平解决方案的人。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Russian dissident artist Semyon Skrepezki murdered in Poland
title.zh: 俄罗斯异议艺术家谢苗·斯克列佩茨基在波兰遇害

summary.en: Russian dissident artist Semyon Skrepezki, known for his critical caricatures of President Vladimir Putin, has been murdered in Poland, and a suspected killer has been apprehended.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯异议艺术家谢苗·斯克列佩茨基在波兰遇害，他以讽刺俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的漫画而闻名。一名嫌疑杀手已被逮捕。

body.en:
Skrepezki was known for his scathing caricatures of Russian President Vladimir Putin. His suspected killer has been apprehended.

Semyon Skrepezki was shot dead near his Biala Podlaska apartment on June 15 around 9:50 a.m., according to the Lublin prosecutor's office. Three of the five shots were fired after Skrepezki had already collapsed on the ground. He died at the scene. The perpetrator fled but was apprehended three days later. Five shell casings and a nine millimeter Luger bullet were found at the crime scene.

This is the same ammunition that was used in the 2019 killing of Chechen field commander Zelimkhan Khangoshvili in Berlin . Maxim Kusminov, a Russian helicopter pilot who defected to Ukraine, was also shot and killed with a weapon of the same caliber in 2024, reports independent Russian news outlet Agentstwo .

Skrepezki's suspected killer was arrested near the Polish capital Warsaw, according to a statement posted by Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk on X on June 18. The suspect was using a Georgian passport, according to Tusk and the Polish prosector's office. Polish authorities are now working to identify the person who orchestrated Skrepezki's murder, Tusk added.

Speaking at a press conference on the previous day, Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said the murder bore all the hallmarks of a political assassination. Yet he also said further evidence and leads were required before reaching any conclusions. He stated that if the killing proved to be Russian-orchestrated, it would constitute a very serious incident of international significance, equating to "state terrorism."

Polish media outlets have described Skrepezki as an outspoken critic of Russian President Vladimir Putin and speculated whether his murder could have been a contract killing. "It looked like an execution," one official familiar with the case told Polish news portal Onet .

Belarusian performance artist Vlad Bokhan, who was in contact with Skrepezki shortly before his death, also believes his killing may have been politically motivated. Bokhan told DW the killing likely served two purposes, namely to "eliminate a person, and to intimidate." The murder "sends a message to those who engage in similar activities," the artist added.

Skrepezki war born in Russia in 1981 as Robert Kuzovkov. He lived in Siberia's Altai region until 2021, after which he fled to Poland out of fear of political persecution where he was granted protected status.

He was best known for his political cartoons, including depictions of Russian President Vladimir Putin, Chechen leader Ramzan Kadyrov, late Russian opposition politician Alexei Navalny  and Belarusian leader Alexander Lukashenko .

He also organized protests in various cities across Europe. Skrepezki published...
body.zh: 斯克雷佩兹基因其对俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的严厉讽刺而闻名。杀害他的嫌疑人已被逮捕。 据卢布林检察官办公室称，6 月 15 日上午 9 点 50 分左右，谢苗·斯克雷佩兹基 (Semyon Skrepezki) 在他位于 Biala Podlaska 的公寓附近被枪杀。五枪中的三枪是在斯克雷佩兹基已经倒在地上后发射的。他当场死亡。肇事者逃跑，但三天后被捕。犯罪现场发现了五枚弹壳和一颗九毫米鲁格子弹。 这与 2019 年在柏林杀害车臣战地指挥官 Zelimkhan Khangoshvili 时使用的弹药相同。据俄罗斯独立新闻媒体 Agentstwo 报道，叛逃到乌克兰的俄罗斯直升机飞行员马克西姆·库斯米诺夫 (Maxim Kusminov) 也在 2024 年被同口径武器枪杀。 据波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克6月18日在X上发布的声明，斯克雷佩兹基的凶手嫌疑人在波兰首都华沙附近被捕。图斯克和波兰检察官办公室称，嫌疑人使用的是格鲁吉亚护照。图斯克补充说，波兰当局目前正在努力查明策划谋杀斯克雷佩兹基的人。 波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克在前一天的新闻发布会上表示，这起谋杀案具有政治暗杀的所有特征。但他也表示，在得出任何结论之前，还需要进一步的证据和线索。他表示，如果这起杀戮被证明是俄罗斯精心策划的，这将构成具有国际意义的非常严重事件，相当于“国家恐怖主义”。 波兰媒体将斯克雷佩兹基描述为俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的直言不讳的批评者，并猜测他的谋杀是否可能是一次合同杀人。一位熟悉此案的官员告诉波兰新闻门户网站 Onet：“这看起来像是一次处决。” 白俄罗斯表演艺术家弗拉德·博坎（Vlad Bokhan）在斯克雷佩兹基去世前不久与他有过接触，他也认为他的杀戮可能是出于政治动机。博坎告诉德国之声，这次杀戮可能有两个目的，即“消灭一个人，以及恐吓”。这位艺术家补充说，这起谋杀案“向那些从事类似活动的人发出了一个信息”。 Skrepezki War 1981 年出生于俄罗斯，原名罗伯特·库佐夫科夫 (Robert Kuzovkov)。他一直住在西伯利亚的阿尔泰地区，直到 2021 年，之后，由于担心受到政治迫害，他逃到了波兰，在那里他获得了受保护的身份。 他以其政治漫画而闻名，其中包括对俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京、车臣领导人拉姆赞·卡德罗夫、已故俄罗斯反对派政治家阿列克谢·纳瓦尔尼和白俄罗斯领导人亚历山大·卢卡申科的描绘。 他还在欧洲多个城市组织了抗议活动。斯克雷佩兹基发表...

reflection.en: The tragic murder of Semyon Skrepezki, known for his critical art, reminds us of the profound dangers faced by those who challenge powerful, oppressive regimes. This verse speaks to the destructive nature of wicked rulers, whose actions can leave people vulnerable and without recourse. It underscores the heavy cost paid by individuals who dare to speak...
reflection.zh: 斯克列佩茨基这位以批判性艺术闻名的异议艺术家被谋杀的悲剧，提醒我们那些挑战强大压迫政权的人所面临的深重危险。这节经文谈到了邪恶统治者的破坏性本质，他们的行为可能使人民脆弱无助。它强调了在这样的背景下，敢于说出真相的个人所付出的沉重代价。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: World Cup: Ivory Coast's Elye Wahi denied entry to Canada
title.zh: 世界杯：科特迪瓦球员瓦希被加拿大拒绝入境

summary.en: Ivory Coast striker Elye Wahi was denied entry to Canada due to an ongoing investigation in France concerning allegations of match-fixing. The 23-year-old, who plays for Eintracht Frankfurt, is among several players to face Canadian visa denials.
summary.zh: 科特迪瓦前锋埃利耶·瓦希因在法国涉嫌操纵比赛的指控而正在接受调查，被加拿大拒绝入境。这位23岁、效力于法兰克福的球员并非首位被加拿大拒签的运动员。

body.en:
Elephants striker Elye Wahi is being investigated in France in connection to allegations of match-fixing. The 23-year-old, who is contracted to Eintracht Frankfurt, is not the first player to be denied a Canadian visa.

Ivory Coast striker Elye Wahi has been denied entry to Canada ahead of the "Elephants'"  World Cup game against Germany in Toronto on Saturday due to match-fixing allegations.

Wahi, who is under contract at German Bundesliga club Eintracht Frankfurt but was on loan at French Ligue 1 side OGC Nice last season, is currently being investigated by authorities in Marseille in connection to allegations of "organized fraud, organized sports corruption, handling of proceeds of crime and money laundering," according to a statement provided to The New York Times (NYT).

The allegations concern in particular a Ligue 1 fixture between Nice and FC Metz (0-0) on May 17 in which the 23-year-old is alleged to have intentionally picked up a yellow card.

In a statement, the French Football League (LFP) said they had been made aware of "an unusual volume of bets relating to a booking involving the player Elye Wahi."

According to the NYT, Wahi was arrested on by French police on May 29 – just hours after scoring two goals in a play-off win against AS St. Etienne, which kept Nice in Ligue 1 – but was released without charge as investigations continued.

Having not been charged with a crime, Wahi's entry into the United States , where Ivory Coast are based and where Wahi started in a 1-0 win over Ecuador in Philadelphia on Sunday, was deemed unproblematic.

But Canadian authorities have taken a stricter line, with the Ivorian Football Federation (FIF) confirming on Thursday that the "necessary administrative authorization for [Wahi's] entry into Canadian territory could not be obtained at this stage."

They said Wahi would therefore "remain in the United States pending the team's return" ahead of Ivory Coast's third Group E game against Curacao in Philadelphia on Thursday.

"At this particularly delicate time, the FIF extends its full support to the player and reaffirms its confidence in him," concluded the statement, adding that "Elye Wahi remains an important element of the Ivory Coast national team."

Wahi is not the first player to be denied entry to Canada due to ongoing investigations abroad.

Last week, Ghana 's Thomas Partey was refused a Canadian visa due to rape and sexual abuse charges in the United Kingdom , to which he has pleaded not guilty.

Wahi was born in Paris and represented France at youth level before opting to play for Ivory Coast. He has since made three appearances for the Elephants.

The allegations could also have ramifications for Eintracht Frankfurt who, following the season-long loan to Nice and the World...
body.zh: 大象队前锋埃利·瓦希因涉嫌操纵比赛而在法国接受调查。这位与法兰克福签约的 23 岁球员并不是第一个加拿大签证被拒的球员。 科特迪瓦前锋埃利·瓦希 (Elye Wahi) 在周六多伦多举行的“大象”世界杯对阵德国队的比赛之前被拒绝入境加拿大，原因是他涉嫌操纵比赛。 根据《纽约时报》提供的一份声明，瓦希目前与德甲俱乐部法兰克福队签订合同，但上赛季被租借到法甲球队尼斯，目前正在接受马赛当局的调查，指控其“有组织欺诈、有组织体育腐败、处理犯罪所得和洗钱”。 这些指控尤其涉及 5 月 17 日尼斯与梅斯俱乐部 (0-0) 之间的法甲比赛，据称这名 23 岁的球员故意吃到一张黄牌。 法国足球联盟（LFP）在一份声明中表示，他们已获悉“涉及球员埃利·瓦希（Elye Wahi）的黄牌相关投注量异常大”。 据《纽约时报》报道，瓦希于 5 月 29 日被法国警方逮捕，当时瓦希在附加赛对阵圣艾蒂安的附加赛中攻入两球，帮助尼斯保住了法甲联赛的席位，但随着调查的继续，瓦希被无罪释放。 由于没有被指控犯罪，瓦希进入美国被认为是没有问题的。美国是科特迪瓦队的所在地，瓦希周日在费城 1-0 战胜厄瓜多尔的比赛中首发出场。 但加拿大当局采取了更严格的措施，科特迪瓦足协(FIF)周四确认，“现阶段无法获得[瓦希]进入加拿大领土所需的行政授权。” 他们表示，瓦希将因此“留在美国，等待球队返回”，周四科特迪瓦将在费城与库拉索队进行 E 组第三场比赛。 声明最后表示：“在这个特别微妙的时刻，国际足联向这名球员提供全力支持，并重申对他的信心。”并补充说，“埃利·瓦希仍然是科特迪瓦国家队的重要组成部分。” 瓦希并不是第一个因国外正在进行的调查而被拒绝进入加拿大的球员。 上周，加纳的托马斯·帕蒂因在英国遭受强奸和性虐待指控而被拒绝申请加拿大签证，但他对此表示不认罪。 瓦希出生于巴黎，曾代表法国青年队参加比赛，后来选择为科特迪瓦效力。此后，他已为大象队出场 3 次。 这些指控也可能对法兰克福产生影响，在租借给尼斯和世界足联一个赛季之后......

reflection.en: Allegations of match-fixing in sports highlight the importance of integrity and fair play in all aspects of life. Yahweh detests dishonest scales, reminding us that true success is built on uprightness, not manipulation. This principle extends beyond commerce to every arena where trust and fairness are essential.
reflection.zh: 体育赛事中操纵比赛的指控，凸显了诚信和公平竞争在生活各个方面的重要性。雅伟憎恶不诚实，提醒我们真正的成功是建立在正直而非操纵之上的。这一原则不仅适用于商业，也适用于所有需要信任和公平的领域。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.zh: 中国观察

strap.zh: 聚焦中国内部政策走向、社会变化与国家动态。

title.en: For women in China frustrated by sexism, female comics are offering a release
title.zh: 在中国，女性喜剧演员为厌倦性别歧视的女性提供宣泄出口

summary.en: Standup comedy in China is providing a platform for women to discuss sensitive topics, including sexism, offering a sense of release and shared experience. Performers, however, remain cautious of censorship limits as they navigate this space in venues like a small performing arts theatre in east Beijing.
summary.zh: 中国的脱口秀喜剧为女性提供了一个平台，让她们可以讨论包括性别歧视在内的敏感话题，从而获得宣泄和共同的体验。然而，表演者们在北京东部一家小型表演艺术剧院等场所进行表演时，仍对审查限制保持警惕。

body.en: Standup comedy gives women a space to talk about certain topics that have become more sensitive, while performers remain wary of censorship limits Packed into the upstairs theatre of a small performing arts space in east Beijing, more than 100 people, mostly women, are giddy with anticipation. “Who did you come to see?” asks the MC, fashionably dressed in a faded denim two-piece suit. The answer is bellowed in unison back to him: “Fang Zhuren!” Fang Shaoli, AKA Director Fang ( Fang Zhuren ), has built a cult following in China in the past two years. Decidedly less fashionable than the evening’s host, Fang is dressed in a yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans. Her everywoman attire is part of the appeal. With a stout frame and short, sensible haircut, Fang, who was born in 1975, hails from rural part of east China’s Shandong province. Before discovering the art of standup comedy she worked in factories and on construction sites, but mainly lived as a housewife to a difficult husband. Her jokes riff on the deep sexism that permeates Chinese culture, particularly away from the big urban centres like Beijing and Shanghai. Continue reading...
body.zh: 单口喜剧为女性提供了谈论某些变得更加敏感的话题的空间，而表演者们仍然对审查制度的限制保持警惕北京东部一个小型表演艺术空间的楼上剧场里，有 100 多人（其中大部分是女性）满怀期待。 “你是来看谁的？”身穿褪色牛仔两件套西装的主持人问道。对方齐声喊道：“方主任！”方绍立，又名方主任（方主任），过去两年在中国建立了一批狂热的追随者。方穿着黄色连帽衫和深蓝色牛仔裤，明显不如当晚主持人时尚。她的普通女性着装是其吸引力的一部分。方出生于1975年，来自中国东部山东省的农村地区，身材魁梧，留着一头漂亮的短发。在发现单口喜剧艺术之前，她曾在工厂和建筑工地工作过，但主要是作为一位难相处的丈夫的家庭主妇生活。她的笑话反复提及了渗透在中国文化中的根深蒂固的性别歧视，尤其是在远离北京和上海等大城市中心的地方。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story highlights the human need to express frustrations and experiences, especially when facing societal pressures like sexism. Proverbs 31:8-9 reminds us of the importance of speaking up for those whose voices are often unheard, advocating for justice and dignity. Even in challenging environments, creative expression can offer a vital space for shared...
reflection.zh: 这个故事突显了人类表达挫折和经历的需求，尤其是在面对性别歧视等社会压力时。箴言31:8-9提醒我们，为那些常常被忽视的声音发声，倡导公义和尊严是何等重要。即使在充满挑战的环境中，创造性的表达也能为共同的理解和释放提供一个重要的空间，这反映了雅伟对边缘群体的关怀。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Border Force officer and Hong Kong trade official jailed for spying for China
title.zh: 英国边境部队官员和香港贸易官员因替中国从事间谍活动被判入狱

summary.en: A UK Border Force officer and a Hong Kong trade official have been sentenced to 10 and eight years in prison, respectively, after being convicted of spying for China. These are the first convictions under the UK's National Security Act.
summary.zh: 一名英国边境部队官员和一名香港贸易官员因替中国从事间谍活动而被判入狱，刑期分别为10年和8年。这是英国根据《国家安全法》首次定罪的案件。

body.en: Peter Wai and Bill Yuen sentenced to 10 and eight years at Old Bailey in first convictions under National Security Act A UK Border Force officer and a Hong Kong trade official based in London have been jailed for spying for China in the first such conviction in British criminal history. Peter Wai, who conducted “shadow policing” operations on Chinese dissidents in the UK, was sentenced to 10 years, while his handler, Bill Yuen, received an eight-year term. Continue reading...
body.zh: Peter Wai和Bill Yuen根据《国家安全法》首次在老贝利被判刑10年和8年。一名英国边防部队官员和一名驻伦敦的香港贸易官员因为中国从事间谍活动而被判入狱，这是英国犯罪史上的首次此类定罪。在英国对中国持不同政见者进行“影子警察”行动的韦彼得被判处10年徒刑，而他的经纪人袁比尔则被判处8年徒刑。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news highlights the profound breach of trust when public officials betray their duties. Yahweh's word reminds us that faithfulness in small responsibilities reflects our character in larger ones. May we all strive for integrity in every role we are given, understanding that honesty builds trust and strengthens the fabric of society.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻凸显了公职人员背叛职责时对信任的严重破坏。雅伟的话语提醒我们，在小事上忠心的人，在大事上也忠心。愿我们都在所担任的每一个角色中追求正直，明白诚实能建立信任并巩固社会结构。

verse.textEn: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
verse.textZh: 人在最小的事上忠心，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不义，在大事上也不义。

title.en: Inspired by Ukraine, and worried by China: Taiwan teaches its citizens how to fly drones
title.zh: 受乌克兰启发，担忧中国大陆：台湾教导市民如何驾驶无人机

summary.en: Ordinary citizens in Taiwan are enrolling in drone piloting courses, inspired by events in Ukraine and concerned about a potential military threat from China. These courses teach participants, young and old, how to operate drones for various purposes.
summary.zh: 受乌克兰局势的启发并担忧中国大陆的军事威胁，台湾普通民众（包括年轻人和老年人）正在参加无人机驾驶课程。这些课程旨在教授学员如何操作无人机以应对潜在情况。

body.en: Ordinary Taiwanese, young and old, are joining courses to learn how to fly drones amid looming China military threat In a small, crowded room in Taipei, Pan Chien-chin is trying to keep a drone hovering steadily. Imagining himself flying a plane, he gently nudges controller joysticks to guide the insect-like device as it hums through the air. Cheers break out as Pan, who has never flown a drone before, steers it around a rectangular course marked by traffic cones without crashing. Around him are about two dozen fellow trainees, all signed up for the same course: Taiwan’s first civil defence drone training programme. Continue reading...
body.zh: 台湾普通民众，无论老少，都在参加课程，学习如何在迫在眉睫的中国军事威胁下驾驶无人机。在台北一间拥挤的小房间里，潘建钦正努力让无人机保持稳定盘旋。他想象自己驾驶一架飞机，轻轻推动控制器操纵杆，引导昆虫般的设备在空中嗡嗡作响。当潘以前从未驾驶过无人机时，他驾驶无人机绕着一个由交通锥标标记的矩形航线飞行，没有坠毁，引发了欢呼声。他周围大约有两打学员，他们都报名参加同一门课程：台湾首个民防无人机训练计划。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The story highlights a community's proactive response to perceived threats, reflecting a natural human inclination to prepare for potential dangers. Proverbs reminds us of the wisdom in foreseeing trouble and taking steps to protect ourselves and our communities. Such foresight, when coupled with a reliance on Yahweh, can guide us in uncertain times.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻讲述了一个社区如何积极应对潜在威胁，反映了人类为可能出现的危险做准备的自然倾向。箴言提醒我们，预见祸患并采取措施保护自己和社区是智慧之举。这种远见，若能与对雅伟的信靠结合，便能在不确定的时期指引我们。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Lululemon apologises after Japanese drum row at Great Wall yoga event
title.zh: Lululemon因长城瑜伽活动中的日本太鼓风波致歉

summary.en: The activewear brand Lululemon issued an apology after an online uproar in China. The controversy stemmed from a promotional yoga event held on the Great Wall of China, where a Japanese taiko drum was mistakenly featured instead of a Chinese drum, despite the event being intended to celebrate Chinese culture.
summary.zh: 运动服饰品牌Lululemon因在中国长城举办的瑜伽推广活动中误用日本太鼓而引发网络争议后，发表了道歉声明。尽管该活动旨在庆祝中国文化，但这一失误在中国引发了线上轩然大波。

body.en: Online uproar follows Canadian brand’s use of taiko drum at sponsored festival held to celebrate Chinese culture The activewear brand Lululemon has apologised after a promotional event held on the Great Wall of China appeared to mistakenly feature a Japanese drum, prompting an uproar. The Canadian-headquartered company, known for its upmarket leggings, has been growing rapidly in China and arranged for a yoga festival to take place in late May on a section of the wall near Beijing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 加拿大品牌在为庆祝中国文化而举办的赞助节日上使用太鼓，在中国引起网络轩然大波运动服品牌 Lululemon 在中国长城举行的一次促销活动中错误地使用了日本太鼓，引发轩然大波，该品牌已道歉。这家总部位于加拿大的公司以其高档瑜伽紧身裤而闻名，在中国发展迅速，并于五月底在北京附近的一段长城举办了一场瑜伽节。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This incident reminds us how quickly a seemingly small cultural misstep can ignite widespread public sentiment, especially in the digital age. Just as a tiny spark can set a vast forest ablaze, unintentional actions or symbols can inadvertently cause significant uproar and division. It underscores the need for careful consideration and humility in our...
reflection.zh: 这起事件提醒我们，一个看似微小的文化失误，尤其在数字时代，能多么迅速地引发广泛的公众情绪。正如一点火花能点燃整片森林，无意的行为或象征也可能不经意间造成巨大的争议和分歧。这强调了我们在互动中需要谨慎思考和谦卑，认识到即使是微小的细节也可能产生深远的影响。

verse.textEn: The tongue is a small part of the body, but it makes great boasts. Consider what a great forest is set on fire by a small spark.
verse.textZh: 舌头在百体里也是最小的，却能说大话。看哪，最小的火能点着最大的树林。

title.en: They were forced into marriage and abused. Now women facing exploitation in China have a glimmer of hope
title.zh: 她们被迫结婚并遭受虐待。现在，中国面临剥削的女性有了一线希望

summary.en: Female activists are secretly working to locate and assist vulnerable women in China who have been forced into marriage and subjected to abuse, as they believe authorities are not adequately protecting them.
summary.zh: 在中国，女性活动家们正在秘密寻找并帮助那些被迫结婚并遭受虐待的弱势女性，因为她们担心官方未能提供足够的保护。

body.en: Female activists are working in the shadows to find and support vulnerable women they fear are being failed by authorities Last summer, Xiaocao, a softly spoken woman in her 40s, received a tip-off that in Lüliang, a small city in China’s Shanxi province, vulnerable women were being forced into marriages. Along with another volunteer, she wanted to investigate. After leaving Beijing, the two volunteers travelled south for hours, on trains and in rental cars. A few villages turned out to be dead ends. But on the final day of their trip, the women stopped in a county where they’d heard about a woman with learning disabilities who was “married” to two brothers. Soon, they found her. Continue reading...
body.zh: 女性活动人士正在暗中寻找和支持她们担心当局辜负的弱势女性。去年夏天，40 多岁、说话轻声细语的小曹接到举报，称在中国山西省的一个小城市吕梁，弱势女性正在被迫结婚。她想和另一名志愿者一起进行调查。离开北京后，两名志愿者乘坐火车和租车向南行驶了几个小时。一些村庄变成了死胡同。但在旅行的最后一天，妇女们在一个县停下来，她们听说那里有一名有学习障碍的妇女“嫁给”了两个兄弟。很快，他们就找到了她。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story highlights the courageous work of activists who step in when vulnerable individuals are failed by systems meant to protect them. Their efforts embody the call to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, advocating for justice and dignity for the exploited.
reflection.zh: 这个故事彰显了活动家们的勇气，当弱势群体未能得到应有的保护时，她们挺身而出。她们的努力体现了为那些无法为自己发声的人说话的呼召，为受剥削者争取正义和尊严。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: The Guardian view on the global baby bust: people are having fewer children – even where they say they want more | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》观点：全球生育率暴跌——人们生育的孩子越来越少，即使他们说想要更多 | 社论

summary.en: A new report indicates that global fertility rates are falling faster and spreading further than anticipated, with India's fertility now below the level needed for population stability. This trend means that two-thirds of the world's population now lives in countries with declining birth rates.
summary.zh: 一份新报告指出，全球生育率下降的速度和范围都超出了预期，印度生育率已降至维持人口稳定所需的水平以下。这一趋势意味着全球三分之二的人口生活在生育率下降的国家。

body.en: Indian fertility has fallen below the rate required for population stability, in further evidence of the unexpectedly rapid decline in births internationally The global fall in fertility rates has arrived faster and spread further than anticipated. Two-thirds of people now live in countries that have slipped below the replacement rate – 2.1 births per woman – required for a stable population. Last month, India revealed that its fertility rate had fallen to just 1.9 . The world’s two most populous nations, which pursued cruel and coercive policies to cut births, both face shrinking populations. China’s fertility rate is now around 1, and births last year fell below 8 million – just over half the number projected when the “one child” policy was axed 10 years ago, and comparable to the total in 1738, when its population was 150 million. It’s further proof that what was seen as a phenomenon of rich nations has spread far beyond them. East Asia led the way. But Albania and Chile have far lower rates than the US or England and Wales (themselves experiencing record lows of 1.6 and 1.4). Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 印度的生育率已降至人口稳定所需的水平以下，这进一步证明了国际上出生率出人意料地迅速下降。全球生育率下降的速度和蔓延范围都超出了预期。目前，三分之二的人口生活在人口更替率（每名妇女生育 2.1 胎）以下的国家。上个月，印度透露其生育率已降至仅 1.9。世界上两个人口最多的国家都推行残酷和强制性的政策来减少生育，但都面临着人口萎缩的问题。目前中国的生育率约为1，去年的出生人数跌至800万以下——仅略高于10年前取消“独生子女”政策时预计数字的一半，与1738年的总人口相当，当时的人口为1.5亿。这进一步证明，被视为富裕国家现象的现象已经远远超出了它们的范围。东亚处于领先地位。但阿尔巴尼亚和智利的利率远低于美国或英格兰和威尔士（它们自己也经历过 1.6 和 1.4 的历史低点）。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The global decline in birth rates highlights a significant shift in societal patterns regarding family and future generations. Psalm 127:3 reminds us that children are a heritage from Yahweh, a reward and a blessing that enrich life and carry hope for the future. This perspective invites reflection on the profound value of each new life.
reflection.zh: 全球生育率下降的趋势，反映了社会在家庭和未来世代模式上的重大转变。诗篇127:3提醒我们，儿女是雅伟所赐的产业，是祂所给的赏赐，他们丰富生命，承载着未来的希望。这一视角邀请我们反思每个新生命的深远价值。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: From camel coats to guochao: Max Mara woos China’s luxury brand consumers
title.zh: 从骆驼绒大衣到国潮：Max Mara如何吸引中国奢侈品消费者

summary.en: Luxury fashion brand Max Mara celebrated its 75th anniversary with a catwalk show in Shanghai, paying tribute to Chinese style to attract consumers in China's growing luxury market.
summary.zh: 奢侈时尚品牌Max Mara在上海举办了75周年时装秀，以中国风情致敬当地文化，旨在吸引中国日益增长的奢侈品市场消费者。

body.en: Fashion house pays tribute to Chinese style with its 75th anniversary catwalk show in Shanghai “New York may be the city that never sleeps, but Shanghai doesn’t even sit down.” For the British designer Ian Griffiths, who encountered this line in the New Yorker, it summed up why China’s biggest city was the right place to celebrate Max Mara’s 75th anniversary. “Max Mara is a product for metropolitan women, and it would be patronising to assume that a metropolitan wardrobe should be western-centric,” Griffiths said. Continue reading...
body.zh: 时装屋在上海举办 75 周年时装秀，向中国风致敬 “纽约可能是不夜城，但上海却从不坐下。”对于在《纽约客》上看到这句话的英国设计师 Ian Griffiths 来说，它总结了为什么中国最大的城市是庆祝 Max Mara 75 周年的最佳地点。 “Max Mara 是一款专为都市女性设计的产品，如果认为都市女性的衣橱应该以西方为中心，那就太居高临下了，”Griffiths 说道。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The allure of luxury fashion and the relentless pursuit of market share highlight the powerful draw of material wealth and worldly success. This story invites us to consider where our ultimate devotion lies, reminding us that our hearts cannot be fully given to both God and the pursuit of riches.
reflection.zh: 奢华时尚的魅力和对市场份额的孜孜不倦，凸显了物质财富和世俗成功的强大吸引力。这个故事邀请我们思考我们最终的忠诚所在，提醒我们不能同时全心全意地侍奉雅伟和追求财富。

verse.textEn: No one can serve two masters... You cannot serve both God and Mammon.
verse.textZh: 一个人不能事奉两个主……你们不能又事奉神，又事奉玛门。

title.en: US military plans major war stockpile on Australian soil
title.zh: 美国军方计划在澳大利亚建立大型战争储备

summary.en: The United States military is planning a significant accumulation of weapons on Australian territory. This move is described as a key part of an Asia-wide regional defense strategy aimed at countering the growing influence of China.
summary.zh: 美国军方正计划在澳大利亚领土上大量储备武器。此举被描述为一项旨在对抗中国崛起势力的亚洲区域防御战略的关键组成部分。

body.en:
The US military is planning a permanent war-ready weapons stockpile for its marine corps on Australia's southeast coast beyond the range of most Chinese missiles, tender documents show and officials confirmed to the Agence France-Presse news agency (AFP).

The development of the stockpile, a first for the US marine corps in Australia, comes as the United States is keen to leverage the continent's strategic location in the South Pacific to counter China's rapid military build-up, analysts said.

The US marine corps began global prepositioning of military supplies during the Cold War — using floating stores on ships and caves in Norway where weapons, ammunition and vehicles to sustain thousands of troops are kept.

The first land stockpile in the Asia-Pacific region is expected to open this year in the Philippines, close to potential flashpoints in the South China Sea.

Documents published by the US navy this month show advanced planning for an even larger Australian stockpile, with US$30 million ($42.4M) allocated to build warehouses and offices in southeastern Victoria state for "critical forward provisioning".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The Australian stockpile, expected to reach full capacity by 2028, will be kept in Melbourne before being moved to US warehouses to be constructed next year at an Australian military base at Bandiana in rural Victoria, tender documents show.

Australia does not permit foreign military bases on its soil, a sensitive issue in a country that has a security alliance with the United States and is hosting an increasing variety of US forces on rotation at Australian defence bases.

The US navy is engaging a global defence contractor to employ around 110 engineers, mechanics, material and safety specialists to manage the Australian stockpile, which includes "crew-served weapons", the documents show.

"Marine corps activities in Australia support integrated global sustainment by maintaining ready-for-issue equipment and supplies for operations and exercises across the Indo-Pacific," a US marine corps forces pacific spokesperson told AFP.

The spokesperson declined to comment on contract details or force planning assumptions but said marines' equipment is kept at "high readiness".

Contracting arrangements and the operation of the facility would be made in close coordination with Australia's Department of Defence.

"These activities improve responsiveness, strengthen interoperability with allies and partners, and support a range of missions across the Indo-Pacific," the spokesperson said, using an alternative description for the Asia-Pacific region.

US army trucks were left at the Bandiana base in 2023 after...
body.zh: 招标文件显示，官员们向法新社（法新社）证实，美国军方正计划在澳大利亚东南海岸为其海军陆战队建立一个永久性的战备武器库存，该武器库位于大多数中国导弹的射程之外。 分析人士表示，这是美国海军陆战队在澳大利亚的首次军备建设，正值美国热衷于利用澳大利亚在南太平洋的战略位置来对抗中国的快速军事集结。 冷战期间，美国海军陆战队开始在全球预先部署军事物资——使用挪威船只和洞穴上的浮动仓库，存放武器、弹药和车辆，以维持数千名士兵的生命。 亚太地区第一个陆地储备预计将于今年在菲律宾开放，靠近南中国海的潜在爆发点。 美国海军本月发布的文件显示，澳大利亚对更大规模的库存进行了高级规划，其中拨款 3000 万美元（合 4240 万美元）用于在维多利亚州东南部建造仓库和办公室，用于“关键的前沿供应”。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 招标文件显示，澳大利亚的库存预计将在 2028 年达到满负荷，将存放在墨尔本，然后转移到明年在维多利亚州乡村班迪亚纳的澳大利亚军事基地建造的美国仓库。 澳大利亚不允许在其领土上建立外国军事基地，这对于一个与美国结成安全联盟并在澳大利亚国防基地轮流驻有越来越多美军的国家来说是一个敏感问题。 文件显示，美国海军正在聘请一家全球国防承包商，聘请约 110 名工程师、机械师、材料和安全专家来管理澳大利亚库存，其中包括“船员服务武器”。 美国海军陆战队太平洋发言人告诉法新社：“海军陆战队在澳大利亚的活动通过为整个印太地区的行动和演习提供随时可用的设备和物资来支持全球综合保障。” 该发言人拒绝就合同细节或部队规划假设发表评论，但表示海军陆战队的装备保持“高度准备状态”。 该设施的合同安排和运营将与澳大利亚国防部密切协调。 这位发言人表示：“这些活动提高了响应能力，加强了与盟友和伙伴的互操作性，并支持印太地区的一系列任务。”他用了对亚太地区的另一种描述。 2023 年，美军卡车被留在班迪亚纳基地……

reflection.en: News of increasing military stockpiles highlights the ongoing global tension and the human tendency to seek security through arms. Yet, the prophetic vision reminds us of a future where nations transform instruments of war into tools for peace. This hope encourages us to pray for leaders to pursue paths that lead to true and lasting peace, rather than...
reflection.zh: 关于军事储备增加的消息凸显了持续的全球紧张局势以及人类通过武器寻求安全的倾向。然而，先知的异象提醒我们，未来各国将把战争工具转化为和平工具。这一希望鼓励我们为领导人祷告，愿他们寻求通往真正持久和平的道路，而非升级冲突。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Charging ahead: EVs outpace growth predictions
title.zh: 电动汽车：超越增长预期，加速前进

summary.en: Electric vehicles are becoming more affordable, efficient, and capable of longer distances, exceeding initial growth forecasts. China is leading this transition, with Europe and other nations rapidly advancing as well.
summary.zh: 电动汽车正变得更便宜、更高效，续航里程也比以往任何时候都长，其增长速度超出了预期。中国正在推动这一转型，而欧洲和其他国家也正在迅速追赶。

body.zh: 电动汽车变得越来越便宜、越来越高效，而且行驶距离比以往任何时候都更远。中国正在推动这一转型，但欧洲和其他国家正在快速追赶。 全球电动汽车 (EV) 市场的增长速度远远快于预期。短短六年内，销量增长了十倍，到 2025 年，全球电动汽车销量将达到约 2100 万辆。 中国和欧洲处于领先地位，但世界其他地区的市场也在快速增长。 中国长期以来一直在投资太阳能和风能以及电池技术——电动汽车最关键的组成部分。 得益于先进的研究和大规模生产，电动汽车电池成本大幅下降。如今，它们的成本仅为 10 年前的四分之一，而且价格还在继续下降。 中国是世界上最大的汽车市场，消费者正在从政府的产业战略中获益。自 2024 年以来，电动汽车的成本低于内燃机汽车，国家多年来一直在迅速扩大充电基础设施，而且中国的电力非常实惠。 2015年，电动汽车仅占中国新车销量的1%。到 2026 年 4 月，这一比例已攀升至 61%。 电动汽车依靠电力运行并通过电缆充电。在全球范围内，三分之二的电动汽车是所谓的电池电动汽车 (BEV)，仅由电力驱动。剩下的三分之一还配备了燃气发动机，用于长途旅行时的备用——这些被称为增程电动汽车 (EREV) 或插电式混合动力电动汽车 (PHEV)。 相比之下，所谓的混合动力电动汽车 (HEV) 始终需要汽油或柴油来为其内燃机提供动力。电动机提供一些帮助，仅通过再生制动产生电力。这项技术在一定程度上降低了城市驾驶的燃油消耗，但混合动力汽车在国际统计中并未被算作电动汽车。 2018年，电动汽车仅占欧盟新车注册量的1%。到 2026 年 4 月，售出的新车中近三分之一是电动汽车。 北欧处于领先地位。在挪威，现在销售的几乎所有新车都是电动汽车（99%），其次是丹麦（82%）和瑞典（65%）。该地区各国政府支持气候友好型出行，并正在扩大充电基础设施。 在英国，2026 年 4 月注册的新车中有 39% 是电动汽车，其次是德国（37%）和法国（32%）。在这三个国家，电动汽车销量与去年同月相比都翻了一番。 近年来，美国市场陷入停滞。 2023 年至 2025 年间，电动汽车占...

reflection.en: The rapid advancements in electric vehicle technology, making them cheaper and more efficient, reflect a remarkable acceleration of human knowledge and innovation. This progress reminds us of the human capacity to explore and develop new solutions, continually expanding our understanding and capabilities.
reflection.zh: 电动汽车技术日新月异，变得更便宜、更高效，这反映了人类知识和创新的显著加速。这种进步提醒我们，人类有能力探索和开发新的解决方案，不断拓展我们的理解和能力。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Girlfriends review – love and growing pains in queer coming-of-age tale that goes from Hong Kong to Taiwan
title.zh: 女朋友》影评：一部从香港到台湾的酷儿成长故事，充满爱与成长的烦恼

summary.en: The film "Girlfriends" is a romantic drama by Tracy Choi, following one woman's journey from high school to her mid-30s, exploring love and the challenges of growing up within a queer coming-of-age narrative set between Hong Kong and Taiwan.
summary.zh: 电影《女朋友》是崔允信执导的一部浪漫剧情片，讲述了一名女性从高中到三十多岁的人生旅程，探讨了在香港和台湾之间发生的酷儿成长故事中的爱与成长烦恼。

body.en: A trio of actors play one woman from high school to her mid-30s in Tracy Choi’s thoughtful romantic drama It can stretch credibility a little when an actor plays the same character over a long time span in one film. Richard Linklater solved the problem in Boyhood by shooting scenes over succeeding years; AI and de-ageing effects are now an option. With this intimate queer coming-of-age drama, film-maker Tracy Choi instead casts a trio of actors to play one woman from high school to her mid-30s. The three don’t look particularly alike; their temperaments overlap but are by no means identical. The point is perhaps to show how intense the transitions into adulthood are, how unrecognisable are the people we used to be. Working backwards, Girlfriends begins in Hong Kong, where 34-year-old film director Lok (Fish Liew) lives with her actor girlfriend Bei (Jennifer Yu). Five years earlier, Choi released a feature film, but her career has stalled. She is directionless and restless. Bei is also applying pressure to buy a flat and have a baby. The film then rewinds 12 years, to Taiwan, when Lok was a student with spiky orange hair, known as Choi (played by Elizabeth Tang). Some of the best scenes in the film come when her parents visit from Macau; Choi and her girlfriend Qing (Han Ning) have been pretending to be flatmates. Then, as the four of them eat dinner one night, unwilling to keep up the charade, Choi grabs Qing’s hand fiercely over the dinner table. She is coming out to her parents; they understand but say nothing. Another film might give us a big showdown, but this is probably how it would have happened in real life. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在 Tracy Choi 这部深思熟虑的浪漫剧中，三位演员扮演一名从高中到 30 多岁的女性。当一个演员在一部电影中长时间扮演同一个角色时，可信度会有所提高。理查德·林克莱特在《少年时代》中通过连续几年拍摄场景解决了这个问题。人工智能和抗衰老效果现在是一种选择。在这部亲密的酷儿成长剧中，电影制片人崔西·崔 (Tracy Choi) 聘请了三名演员来扮演一名从高中到 30 多岁的女性。这三个人看起来并不是特别相似。他们的性格有重叠，但绝不相同。重点也许是为了表明向成年的转变是多么激烈，我们过去的样子是多么难以辨认。时光倒流，《女朋友》的故事发生在香港，34 岁的电影导演乐（刘静茹饰）和她的演员女友贝（余珍妮饰）住在一起。五年前，崔发布了一部故事片，但她的事业却陷入了停滞。她没有方向，焦躁不安。贝还施加压力，要求买一套公寓并生孩子。影片随后将时间倒回12年前的台湾，当时乐还是一名留着尖尖橙色头发的学生，名叫崔（伊丽莎白·唐饰）。影片中一些最精彩的场景出现在她的父母从澳门来访时；崔和女友青（韩宁饰）一直假装是室友。然后，有一天晚上，当他们四个人吃晚饭时，崔不愿继续玩这个游戏，在餐桌上猛烈地抓住了庆的手。她向父母出柜了；他们明白但什么也没说。另一部电影可能会给我们带来一场大对决，但这可能就是现实生活中发生的情况。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This film explores the complex journey of self-discovery and relationships, highlighting the universal human experience of love and growing pains. In every person's unique path of identity and connection, we are reminded of the profound truth that each individual is created in the image of God, possessing inherent dignity and worth.
reflection.zh: 这部电影探讨了自我发现和关系的复杂旅程，突显了爱与成长烦恼的普世人性体验。在每个人独特的身份和联结之路上，我们都被提醒着一个深刻的真理：每个人都是按照雅伟的形象被创造的，拥有固有的尊严和价值。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Which parties want to cut migration, and how far would they go?
title.zh: 哪些政党希望削减移民，他们会走多远？

summary.en: Migration is back in the spotlight. Here's how the major parties' policies compare.
summary.zh: 移民问题再次成为焦点。以下是主要政党的政策对比。

body.en:
Net migration has fallen to its lowest level since the post-pandemic border reopening — meanwhile the subject is one of the defining political fights of 2026.

New Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) data, released on Thursday, show net overseas migration fell to 301,000 in 2025, down slightly from 306,000 the year before.

Even so, the figure remains above Labor's own targets — with the Coalition and One Nation arguing current levels are still "unsustainable".

The figures were published just a day after One Nation leader Pauline Hanson used her first address to the National Press Club to blame housing pressure on immigration.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

While many experts agree that the level of migration has some effect on housing, they are divided on how significant that effect is.

Matt Grudnoff, senior economist at the progressive political think-tank the Australia Institute, recently told SBS that "data shows that migrants are not having an impact on the housing affordability issues" and in general they have "a positive impact" on the economy.

So how do the major parties actually compare on migration — and is migration really the problem voters are concerned about?

Labor's permanent migration program is capped at 185,000 places for 2026-27 , with 132,240 places — 71 per cent — targeted at skills shortages.

Longer term, the government is aiming for net overseas migration of 225,000 people a year over the next three years.

Treasurer Jim Chalmers has pointed to the latest ABS figures as proof the trend is also lowering, saying migration was "already down 45 per cent since its peak."

On students, Labor's national planning level has a cap of 295,000 international student places for 2026, which it describes as "managed" and "sustainable" growth that supports the international education sector while also maintaining the "integrity of the migration system".

On housing, Immigration Minister Tony Burke has connected migration with the housing crisis, telling Sky News on Monday, "if you go at migration the wrong way, then you can actually make the housing situation worse".

But Labor's primary housing fix is still on the supply side — investing in construction workers, state incentives, and social housing investment — rather than treating migration cuts as the solution.

The Coalition's migration policy centres on what it calls the "Australian values migration plan".

It hasn't committed to a fixed cap, but has hinted at a target "well under 200,000".

reflection.en: The debate over migration policies often challenges societies to consider how they treat those who seek a new home. Yahweh's ancient command reminds us to treat foreigners residing among us as native-born, loving them as ourselves. This principle calls for compassion and equity in our national discussions about welcoming others.
reflection.zh: 关于移民政策的辩论常常挑战社会思考如何对待那些寻求新家园的人。雅伟古老的诫命提醒我们，要将居住在我们中间的外国人视同本地人，爱他们如同爱自己。这一原则呼吁我们在关于接纳他人的国家讨论中，秉持怜悯和公平。

verse.textEn: When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them. The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt.
